title: Soulframe Open Preludes opens free to all PC players on 6 Nov

sources.name: PlayDay.One: Soulframe goes full free-to-play 6 November (cites the Digital Extremes Devstream of 30 Oct and the official patch notes)
TechPowerUp: Digital Extremes's fantasy ARPG Soulframe launches into free open alpha in November
N4G / PCGamesN coverage of Soulframe Open Preludes

first_report: Digital Extremes monthly Devstream, 30 Oct 2026 (official announcement, wording read through PlayDay.One, TechPowerUp, PCGamesN and N4G; soulframe.com homepage still says invitations weekly, the site's own post not found); digest seq 133 03:36Z lists the Japanese coverage 6 Nov 03:15Z
footage: Steam trailer 'Soulframe: Official Gameplay Trailer' (app 4095380), official, 1080p, one continuous stretch 3.0 to 22.2 s; frame sheet checked: no text cards until the end slate at 51 s; no stills

claims.text: Open Preludes opens to all Windows PC players on 6 Nov, free, no invite, no Founder Pack
claims.status: announced by Digital Extremes, reported by four outlets, not read on the studio's own post

claims.text: Omen Wolf mount arrives with Preludes 17 later in November
